finding: Second-born twins had lower Apgar scores at 5 minutes compared to their first-born counterparts, particularly in the context of preterm gestation, monochorionic placentas, and short inter-delivery intervals.
mod_finding: This study examined perinatal outcomes in twin pregnancies, finding that the second twin had lower Apgar scores in relation to gestational age, mode of delivery, inter-delivery interval, and chorionicity.
